title: Crown the Pawn
setup: The white pawn has reached **c7** — one step from a brand-new queen.
hint: Always promote with check when you can. It denies the defender a free move.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{c8=Q+}} promotes with check along the eighth rank. The king cannot take the new queen and nothing can block, so Black must spend its move on the king, and you are left with king and queen against a bare king.

Wait one move instead and {{Kd7}} attacks the pawn, and it is lost. When a pawn can promote safely, promote it now, and prefer the promotion that gives check.
